messages:
olivia: Quick sync — running a short pulse on the SI Embedded Guild onboarding. Need to confirm the handoff checklist for next week's partner-facing session (marketplace listing + HW kit distribution). Who's owning what?

dennis: I can take marketplace metadata and listing QA. Will need final logos and solution brief from partnerships by EOD Thu.

kia: I'll own the HW kit inventory + shipping roster. Still waiting on the serialized parts CSV from procurement. ETA tomorrow.

matt: Heads up — certification micro-credential is still in draft. I can ship the evaluation items but need SME review for the lab tasks. Sophia, can you eyeball?

sophia: Yep, I'll review the lab tasks tonight. Quick note: one task references the old `redwood-cli deploy` flags — we need to update to the new `--env` semantics.

olivia: Good catch. Dennis, update the marketplace snippet to call out the new CLI flag in the lab notes. Also include a short 'rollback' caveat for on-prem installs.

dennis: Will do. Also, partner-bot flagged two partners that need NDAs signed before we ship kits. partner-bot, can you repost which ones?

partner-bot: Automated alert: Partners flagged for NDAs: "Arcadia Systems", "CoreCompute SI". NDA status: Arcadia (pending signature), CoreCompute (signed).

kia: Arcadia pending — I'll hold their kits. Can someone ping legal to expedite?

raj: I'll ping legal + sales ops now. Tagging @legal and @sales-ops in the follow-up thread.

matt: On the certification side, I added a short rubric for pass/fail and an optional "proctor checklist" for field trainings. Sharing snippet here:

```
Proctor checklist v0.1
- Confirm HW arrives and boots to 1.2.3 image
- Run smoke test: `redwood test --quick`
- Validate model artifact download via signed URL
- Record time-to-first-token
```

sophia: Love that. Can we also capture a target SLA for TTF token (e.g., <300ms for local infra)? We should call it out in the playbook so SIs know expectations.

olivia: Yes — add <300ms baseline for on-prem kits and <150ms for cloud marketplace. Dennis, add those numbers to the listing performance notes.

dennis: Added perf numbers to the draft. Also updated the listing description to include link to the proctor checklist doc.

kia: Logistics note — need a single tracking spreadsheet (not multiple forks). I can host one in partnerships drive and share perms.

olivia: Please do and share link here. Also, quick PR plan for the joint announcement: we should coordinate messaging with marketing and legal. I propose a soft embargo until partners confirm NDA and kits shipped.

raj: Agreed. I'll draft the announcement timeline: internal review Fri -> partner approval Mon -> go/no-go Tue.

partner-bot: Reminder: calendar event created — "SI Embedded Guild: Partner Handoff" on Mon 09:00 PT. Invites sent to participants.

olivia: Perfect. Action items recap: Dennis = marketplace listing + perf notes; Kia = HW inventory + tracking sheet; Matt = finalize rubric + lab tasks; Sophia = SME review; Raj = legal + PR timeline. I'll compile and send the final handoff doc Fri. :thumbsup:

sophia: Sounds good. Ping me if you need quick SME decisions tomorrow.

matt: I'll finish the evaluation items tonight and upload to the drive.

dennis: Sending logos to you in DM, olivia.

olivia: Thanks everyone — will close the loop with a single doc and the calendar invite. If anything slips, call it out in this thread so we don't create multiple copies.

kia: Link to tracking sheet: [drive.redwood.com/si-handoff-tracking] (shared with team)

olivia: Received. Closing the pulse for now — we'll reconvene if blockers pop up. :checkered_flag:
